subject.title: feat: unify external sessions with native catalog pagination

question: Should activating the Codex plugin expose the operator session catalog when an existing installation explicitly stores `supervision.enabled: false`?
rationale: The branch changes the privacy and upgrade meaning of an existing explicit setting; tests cannot decide whether that user choice may be narrowed from all session exposure to agent-facing tools only.

options.title: Preserve explicit opt-out
options.body: Keep stored false authoritative for catalog exposure and add a separate explicit catalog enable path if zero-config visibility is desired.

options.title: Approve narrowed opt-out
options.body: Expose the catalog whenever the plugin is active and document the intentional privacy and upgrade change for existing false values.

recommendation.title: Preserve explicit opt-out
recommendation.body: Keep stored false authoritative for catalog exposure and add a separate explicit catalog enable path if zero-config visibility is desired.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced and recently maintained the relevant plugin session lifecycle, Codex catalog, Gateway, and native sidebar boundaries.
